what_happened: In job hvyb, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The job moves code between modules. The reading had a criterion that checked callers by relying on the producer's report. The verifier never sees that report, so it could not judge the criterion. The user replaced it with two checks the verifier can run itself. One is a Grep showing that no file outside the moved module's directory names a moved item by its old module path. The other compares the test list before and after the move, using cargo test -- --list output. This is the fourth time in a row for the same correction, after vrsk, yckz and 6qme.
cause: Three earlier corrections of this flaw changed nothing, because each fix was applied to a single job's reading and then lost. The reading stage has no rule that every criterion must name evidence the verifier can observe itself, and it is not told that the producer's report is invisible to the verifier. Nothing checks a criterion's evidence source before the reading is accepted. For module-move jobs, citing the report is the default way to check callers, so it recurs. Only the user catches it.
prevention: Two parts. (1) Add a rule to the reading brief that every criterion must name evidence the verifier can observe itself (the snapshot, commands it runs, its own tools), and that the producer's report is never evidence. (2) Add a code check on the reading before acceptance. Each criterion must carry an evidence field naming a snapshot path, a command or a tool, and a reading is refused if a criterion cites the producer's report or has no evidence source. For module-move jobs, add default criteria: a Grep showing no file outside the moved module's directory names a moved item by its old module path, and a before/after comparison of cargo test -- --list output.
proposed_request: Make Athena refuse a reading whose acceptance criteria rest on evidence the verifier cannot see. Outcome: when a reading is produced, every acceptance criterion names an evidence source the verifier can observe itself: files in the snapshot, commands the verifier runs, or its own tools such as Grep. A reading that relies on the producer's report, or names no evidence source for a criterion, is rejected before planning and sent back to be rewritten, with a message naming the offending criterion. Also update the reading brief to say that the producer's report is invisible to the verifier. For jobs that move code between modules, the reading's default criteria are: (a) a Grep the verifier runs shows that no file outside the moved module's directory names a moved item by its old module path, and (b) the test list before and after the move is compared using cargo test -- --list output. Acceptance: a test shows a reading citing the producer's report is refused; a test shows a reading with a Grep and a command-based criterion is accepted; the reading brief fits its token budget test; the changelog is not edited by hand.
